insights: Mobile-first carousel layout dominates the content architecture with horizontal scroll-snap containers that create a consistent browsing rhythm across all major content sections (songs, artists, albums, radio, charts).

Card-based modular system uses consistent sizing (152px min-width) and styling (4px border radius, dark backgrounds) across all content types, with subtle variations in image treatment (square vs. circular) to differentiate content categories.

Dark theme color hierarchy leverages subtle tonal shifts (#000 → #121212 → #181818) and opacity variations (white text at 100%, #b3b3b3 for subdued) to create depth without structural dividers, while bright accent green (#1ed760) draws focus to primary CTAs.
Full-bleed horizontal carousels with edge-to-edge scrolling maximize content density on mobile while maintaining 8-16px side margins for visual breathing room and touch-target accessibility.

Z-index layering strategy creates a clear spatial hierarchy: fixed header (z-index: 1020), overlay modals/menus (z-index: 1050-1060), bottom preview banner (z-index: 7), establishing persistent navigation and conversion touchpoints.
